items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: That's when I played that season with the Tuxedo Band. I'll give you the members of that band. Yeah, yeah. Well that band at that time consisted of, first had Bill Matthew on trombone, and Papa Celeste on cornet, and Rick High Lexie on cornet, two cornets.

ctx.x: That was the Young Morgan Band. Well, they called it Sam Morgan Band. Sam Morgan Band. Sam Morgan Band. But, say, Sammy got the best go year. You know, Johnny Day, I picked him right now, standing on Seminole in Claiborne waiting to catch the North Claiborne called the Ride Up Canal Street. Yeah. Well, that same year you're speaking about was John Morrell had got several fellas out there in the tuxedo band to make that record. I see. And he had wanted, Chani Bebe was the drummer, you see, but he was a crack…
So Paul Barch wasn't doing that band anymore then? Who? Paul Barch was gone. Oh no, no. He was up in New York that time.

items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: Ricard was a better reader than Rene was

ctx.x: not too much of a reader I never know Chris to be too much of a reader Sam Morgan I think my idea was a better reader than Chris now Rene we all was puzzled but Rene some of the musicians I've been knowing him all my life but probably he might have been but I know he was not too much of a good reader himself to hear Rene you understand what I mean Ricard was a better reader than Rene was I'm sure he learned that while he's out in Bay St. Louis Mississippi yeah yeah Ricard did and like I said young tuxedo band…
